6064629347432335622.title: Staff of Briarhome
6064629347432335622.description: Grown, not crafted, the staff still bears thorns that drink from moonlight and memory. Its magic flows like sap: slow, sweet, and impossible to cleanse.

6064629347435940106.title: Briarhome Sword
6064629347435940106.description: Its edge glints between etched whorls of vine, the Riverlands' thickets seeming to watch from the steel.

6064629376474742800.title: Grand Master Mining Pickaxe
6064629376474742800.description: More than a tool--a crafted relic that serves as both a covenant and an extension of the mountain's will. It sings with a voice that shatters and shapes the silent stone.

6064629376483852308.title: Grand Master Herbalism Sickle
6064629376483852308.description: The tool of a Grand Master, modeled after a fabled Dunzenkell sickle of sky-iron. Present day Dunir forgecrafters were able to replicate the qualities of the original with astonishing accuracy.

6064629376841547852.title: Sujoma Pauldrons
6064629376841547852.description: Forged in mountain wind and blooded snow, they carry the cold resolve of those who hunted giants with mortal hands.

6064629376946275064.title: Riverstalker Vestment
6064629376946275064.description: Carried by those who walk upstream only when the river forgets its current.

6064629386941169687.title: Tinmyzer's Tome of Applied Magic & Mechanarcana
6064629386941169687.description: This heavy tome is a complex engineering guide for aplied magic devices and theories.

6064629466330431549.title: Crown of Mungle
6064629466330431549.description: The crown is made of a dark porous stone. It is crudely carved and smeels like a bog of stench.

sources.name: This chest has an almost biological appearance to it due to the unconventional materials used to construct it. There seems to be no lock. Along the front side are five faces, each with a slot where a missing eye would be.

6064630140459876475.title: Journeyman Fisherman's Tool Belt
6064630140459876475.description: Cinched with charm, this belt settles around the waist like a tide come in. The sigil it bears honors Guinebelle, Patron of Fishers, Sailors, and Shipwrights.

6064630140763701373.title: Novice Weaponsmith's Shirt
6064630140763701373.description: A heat-bound, ash-kissed garment for those who've begun shaping steel not as metal, but as intention. This is the shirt you ruin. And the one you remember when the steel finally sings.

6064630140774187139.title: Novice Tailor's Shirt
6064630140774187139.description: A garment that teaches its wearer through fit, fiber, and the subtle structure of stitching. Every visible seam is done in the most rudimentary stitch style--a visible reminder of how little you know at the start. If it embarrasses you, good. That's the whole point.

6064630140794175629.title: Journeyman Arcane Engineer's Tool Belt
6064630140794175629.description: Buckled precision and clean design mark this belt as a scholar's harness. Arcane sparks dance across its compartments, craving function.

6064630140827336847.title: Novice Carpenter's Shirt
6064630140827336847.description: Woven strong and cut for motion, this shirt bears the smell of cedar and sweat. Its seams follow the rhythm of timber raised.

6064630214426886486.title: Adventurer's Garb
6064630214426886486.description: The fabric is plain, but sits like it remembers a finer cut. It does not proclaim you a hero. It simply asks if you're ready.

6064630366743757000.title: Brooksteel Wand
6064630366743757000.description: Slender and smooth, the Brooksteel Wand carries the scent of rain and stone. When waved over water, ripples move before the motion, and droplets rise to meet its tip.

6064631081127837749.title: TO: Flame and Formula
6064631081127837749.description: This is large package of artisan resources. It bears the mark of the Greyshore Transporters.

sources.name: This is a large pile of cargo bags that were enroute to various artisan workshops outside of  Aela. Someone needs to deliver them.

6064631120770695171.title: Horse
more: Sinew and spirit in perfect rhythm, the Horse has long been the companion of warriors, wanderers, and kings. Its hooves drum like distant thunder across plains and stone, carrying its rider with speed, grace, and silent resolve. Though lacking the horns or claws of more fearsome beasts, few mounts rival its endurance or loyalty. Muscles ripple beneath a coat of wind-washed hair, and eyes gleam with quiet intelligence, ever alert to threat and command alike. It is not shaped by magic, but by trust and time, and in that lies its power.

sources.name: To help with the trek, the United Tradesfolk are providing me with an old, swaybacked horse. I need to speak to the stablemaster to claim it.

6064631121001906190.title: Wyrmling
6064631121001906190.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

Though lacking the horns or claws of more fearsome beasts, few mounts rival its endurance or loyalty. 6064631121093525562.title: Dawnbreaker
6064631121093525562.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in shimmerwoven aether and kissed by the first light of the celestial dawn, the Mayoral Dawnbreaker of New Aela is no ordinary flying mount. Its form, a sublime fusion of ancient magic and primal grace, defies natural order: the musculature of a great owlbear, the ringed tail of a dusk-born rakari, and the multicolored, translucent wings of a butterfly. It is a living sigil of authority, arcana, and awe.

6064631121103224894.title: Pallas Cat
more: With its round face, thick coat, and flattened ears, the Pallas Cat may resemble an oversized housecat, but its temperament is anything but domestic. Fierce, agile, and surprisingly fast across rugged terrain, this mount is favored by those who appreciate stealth, independence, and a streak of wild defiance. Approach with caution, but ride with pride.

6064631131687157760.title: Verdant Oath Scepter
6064631131687157760.description: Tangled with vine and budding growth, the Verdant Oath Scepter feels alive in hand. When rested on bare earth, small shoots emerge nearby, swaying slightly even without wind.

6064632204307726436.title: Journeyman Enchanting Scroll of the Indestructable
6064632204307726436.description: Deconstruction prevention when enchanting by 20-40%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064632204319850598.title: Apprentice Enchanting Scroll of Second Chance
6064632204319850598.description: -1 level down grade prevention when enchanting by 10-30%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064632204355305577.title: Apprentice Enchanting Scroll of Redemption
6064632204355305577.description: -All Enchantment prevention when enchanting by 10-30%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064632204362907755.title: Novice Enchanting Scroll of Divine Protection
6064632204362907755.description: All negative effect prevention when enchanting by 1-20%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064632209089036292.title: Radiant Rune
6064632209089036292.description: The Radiant Rune is a luminous magical material that infuses weapons with pure, celestial light. When etched onto a weapon, it imbues each strike with radiant energy, dealing dazzling light damage and illuminating the battlefield with a blinding, holy brilliance.

6064632746555736097.title: Embertoss
6064632746555736097.description: Eucidiaeh was the only real threat to Forgelord Zammer's authority. Her hammer had forged blades on par with his yet she was only half his age.

6064632746572906666.title: Rebel's Reward
6064632746572906666.description: The Forgeguard Lassix took particular pleasure in putting down dissenters and rebels. He notched these bracers to celebrate while their blood was still warm on his blade.

6064632746595647737.title: Purifier Breastplate
6064632746595647737.description: Before the apocalypse, Purifiers often found themselves in contention with horrors beyond reckoning. Though diminished in modern times, their armor still boasts wards against those evils.

6064632746659610973.title: Horn of the Great Herd
6064632746659610973.description: An ancient horn, once Wiyakoni's, earned through years of wisdom and service. Cracked with age, it symbolizes his vision, guiding the Ashen Flame toward peace, unity, and a future of harmony and trade.

sources.name: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

With the Horn of the Great Herd cleansed, I must return it to Wiyakoni. Its restoration may restore his leadership and spark a new era of peace, unity, and trade with the Exalted, potentially reshaping the future of the Ashen Flame and the Smolderhoof Path.

6064632752305995777.title: Recipe: The Brace of Balm
6064632752305995777.description: Journeyman Tailoring recipe for creating The Brace of Balm.

6064632757563424800.title: Recipe: Toren Scout Garb
6064632757563424800.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Toren Scout Garb.

6064632773309628418.title: Glittering Steel Ingot
6064632773309628418.description: Can only be processed at the metalworking station in the Befallen Forge.
more:
Process: Metalworking 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing, Jeweler, Armorsmithing, Tailoring, Arcane Engineering, Metalworking

6064632775547813924.title: Key to the Honorsworn
6064632775547813924.description: A red crystal gem rests in the flat of the key. A tag, dangling from the end reads: 'Make your answers known: Allow the Lightcatcher to Drink Deep in the Flames.

sources.name: The key's crystal gem begins to turn color in the fire. After a few seconds, it settles into a glowing red hue.

6064632784205709315.title: Gloomy Pross Seed
more: Gloomy pross seed can be used to grow more gloomy pross.

6064632785179312138.title: Barley Rooting Ball
6064632785179312138.description: This self-fertilizing root ball that will grow barley when planted in a freehold.

6064632937177415691.title: Sandsquall Croc Beast Of Burden
6064632937177415691.description: A fine beast trained to pull caravans.

6064632937891627008.title: Rough Obsidian
6064632937891627008.description:
Gather: Sandsquall Desert 
Ingredient In: Stonemasonry, Alchemy

6064632983119790080.title: Snakebite Wand
6064632983119790080.description: Once wielded by Ssithar, this wand was used to carve fiery paths through the Aelan soldiers on the dunes of war.

6064632983399432194.title: Crate of Justopomints
6064632983399432194.description: Billed as the perfect relief for a scorching summer day, Justopomints became the must-have treat of the season during a particularly nasty bout of arsonry in the village. Transiting this crate to a Guild Commodity Vendor in another village will reward Guild Seals of Valor that can be consumed for Guild XP

6064632983870046332.title: Beetle Horns
6064632983870046332.description:
Drop: Scarab Patriarch 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: Twisted, gnarled protrusions with a faint metallic glint. Said to carry traces of the beetle's formidable strength.

6064632988182577155.title: Crate of Joevan Mudslabs
6064632988182577155.description:
A crate filled with slabs of hardened mud hewn from the riverbanks near Joeva. The unique mixture of sediment creates colorful striations when heated to high temperatures, making it highly desirable for pottery. 

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Crate of Miralethian Flowers

This heavily-perfumed crate is packed with a variety of flower samples gathered from the hills surrounding Miraleth.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of New Aelan Citrus

This crate is packed with sour fruits plucked from New Aelan orchards, valued by nautical travelers for their ability to fend off "the scurvy".

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Winstead Chalk

The chalk circles mined near Winstead and packed into this crate produce a brighter, whiter color prized by artists and alchemists alike.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Aithanahr Glasswares

This crate is packed with glassware of varying shapes and sizes, produced in the distinct style of Aithanahr's artisans.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Azmaranian Whetstones

This weighty crate is filled with whetstones hewed from the cliffs surrounding Azmaran, prized by swordsmen for the extreme sharpness they convey.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064632994427174916.title: Scorpion Venom
more: This thick, amber liquid is extracted from the venom gland of a giant scorpion. It emits a faint, acrid smell and clings stubbornly to any surface it touches.

6064633073104651160.title: Guild War Defectors Declaration Scroll - Joeva
6064633073104651160.description:
DISABLED WHILE INVESTIGATING ISSUES
A Guild Master may consume this scroll to declare war on another Guild.

Defector and Rebel camps will be unconvered. Destroy the Defectors and protect the Rebels to gain victory points.

The first guild to reach 500 victory points win.

6064633112768086030.title: Al'Ashal's Bladder
6064633112768086030.description: The legendary Vaeuline poet, Al'Ashal, carried this with him during his long journey through the Sandsquall Desert.

6064633271738105936.title: Thornstride Twin Daggers
6064633271738105936.description: Solid and balanced, with lines true to the steady rhythm of forgework.

6064633289012412445.title: Coral Embedded Sandstone
6064633289012412445.description:
Drop: Coral Colossus 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: A dense stone laced with veins from the Coral Grotto. Its shimmering hues of red, pink, and blue are prized by traders and sailors for both decoration and construction. The stone's unique structure is shaped by the surrounding coral, making it highly sought after.

6064633289581002828.title: Sandy Bulwark
6064633289581002828.description: Crafted from the melted armor of fallen enemies, this shield was forged by the corrupted Najash and enchanted to greatly enhance its defense.

6064633289679110333.title: Captain Threnody's Mariner Belt
6064633289679110333.description: Legend says that Captain Threnody was tossed in a pit beneath the Brig. There he faced a monstrous beast made from unfortunate prisoners that came before him. If and how he escaped is a tale untold.

6064633289715220753.title: Deadman's Spaulders
6064633289715220753.description: Whoever died in this armor had a spirit that kept it fighting long beyond their corporeal life. Cursed and vengeful, this man's life remains imprinted in the aged leather and steel.

6064633290580295700.title: Stone of Divulgence
6064633290580295700.description: A stone that radiates a mysterious energy... It draws you to towards the outskirts of Sephilion.

6064633290582065173.title: Stone of Discovery
6064633290582065173.description: A stone that radiates a mysterious energy... It draws you to towards the outskirts of Sephilion.

6064633295338995749.description: Journeyman Armorsmithing recipe for creating an Deepwater Cuirass

6064633306257293495.title: Elephant Ear Rooting Ball
6064633306257293495.description: This self-fertilizing root ball that will grow Elephant Ear when planted in a freehold.

6064633306588250118.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea 
Ingredient In: Stonemasonry, Alchemy, Metalworking

6064633306999751061.title: FREEEEEEEE MONEY
6064633306999751061.description: Grants Gold. Obtained by winning Node Siege

6064633328375169063.description:

6064633328377462826.title: Dried Banyan Board
6064633328377462826.description:

6064633328768188592.description:

6064633328781951157.title: Alligator Hide
6064633328781951157.description:
Process: Tanning 
Ingredient In: Tanning, Leatherworking

6064633338862043319.title: Dragon Tree Caravan Chassis
6064633338862043319.description: Supports the structure and functionality of your caravan.

6064633374936465408.title: Eagle Gryphon
6064633374936465408.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health

For PTR use only.

3 hour maximum duration.

6064633391300476943.title: Coin of Silent Oath
6064633391300476943.description: A fine ash clings to the surface of this coin, spilling secrets from hushed voices. Flip it, and you might hear someone else's truth escape in wisp of smoke.

6064633408302219273.title: Novice Glintic Residuum - Armor
6064633408302219273.description: A spectral wisp of magic's purest form, bound to no master, resides within these fragments of unusually volatile Glint.

6064633408302350346.title: Novice Glintic Residuum - Accessory
6064633408302350346.description: A spectral wisp of magic's purest form, bound to no master, resides within these fragments of unusually volatile Glint.

6064633408302743564.title: Apprentice Glintic Residuum - Armor
6064633408302743564.description: A spectral wisp of magic's purest form, bound to no master, resides within these fragments of unusually volatile Glint.

6064633408303005710.title: Apprentice Glintic Residuum - Artisan
6064633408303005710.description: A spectral wisp of magic's purest form, bound to no master, resides within these fragments of unusually volatile Glint.

6064633413336367104.title: Artifact Blessed Enchanting Scroll
6064633413336367104.description: Required to enchant gear, multiplies success chance by 10,000%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064633430589047954.title: Keen Thorn
more: This monstrous cutting is jagged and sharp, its petiole stiff, and leaves grown to a ragged edge.

6064633430596977823.title: Kreeok Longpinion
6064633430596977823.description:
Drop: The Anointer 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: The longest feathers of the Kreeok, bearing vibrant eye-patterns and light-catching stripes. Recent hunters of the Jundark have established a tradition of collecting these feathers to craft luxurious cloaks, blending beauty with status - keeping the Jundark's ubiquitous wet at bay is just a perk

6064633447779926060.title: The Hawk Bow
6064633447779926060.description: Lady Aislinn the Hawk was known to have hit a goblin on the horizon with a single shot. Her eyesight was precise and her arm strong. To match her superior prowess the Hunters of Herne crafted the Hawk Bow.

6064633447851032787.title: Iron Wing Shroud
6064633447851032787.description: The Pools of Stench are tended to by the shrouded Anointer, priests and guardians of the viscous goop that all Kreeok must bathe in to become warriors. Only the shrill of this priest can command the ooze.

6064633447852736792.title: Iron Wing Hood
6064633447852736792.description: The Kreeok's Iron Wing warriors are led by a powerful champion called the Talon Master. His prowess is unmatched and his senses keen. On the battlefield, all Kreeok revere the sight of his Hood.

6064633452969787398.title: Gallant Sailfish
6064633452969787398.description: Can be plucked from the water by a Grandmaster Fisher.

6064633453091160515.title: Titanhelm Barnacle
6064633453091160515.description:
Drop: Barnacle Brenn 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: An oversized dome-shaped barnacle with a hard, extra-thick shell. Its layered structure provides both impact resistance and flexibility. Titan's Helm shells are often repurposed as shields due to their natural curvature and layered strength. These shields often feature tribal and oceanic motifs.

6064633453159711173.title: Basilisk Stone
6064633453159711173.description:
Drop: Zagrazoo the Eyeless 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: Legends say that a swordsman, lost in the Jundark and facing a basilisk, used the monster's petrified dung to hone his blade to a razor's edge. Infused with potent digestive acids and bone fragments, the petrified dung has an abrasive quality prized by artisans and warriors.

6064633453441974280.title: Siege Dampener
6064633453441974280.description: Use this dampener to weaken the settlement tree's bond, reducing the siege banner channel time.

6064633457883873289.title: Wispwhelk Tackle Replicas
6064633457883873289.description:
Unlike the real thing, it won't catch any fish. The painted wood and copper fakes are sold as enchanted bait. Harmless, useless, and definitely not blessed by the whelk god. Their popularity with gullible tourists makes them quite expensive.

This item can be delivered to the Harbor Commodity Vendor in a harbor to gain Materials.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Jars of Leviathan Eyes

Stored in amber-brine jars, they contain stolen memories and forbidden cuisines among the Najash. Slippery and blinking, they occasionally rearrange themselves in the jar.

This item can be delivered to the Harbor Commodity Vendor in a harbor to gain Materials.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Box of Forbidden Maps

A set of hand-drawn charts are stowed inside a folio wrapped in twine. The map markings indicate unknown ruin sites, beast paths, and sacred routes through the jungle. These unreliable, yet highly coveted scrolls contain rumors of hidden treasure.

6064633457990500364.title: Crate of Junskosh Manashackles
6064633457990500364.description:
Forged from the rare metal of the Jundark and strung with nullvine fibers, these handcuffs are the bane of pirate mutineers. When clasped, the shackles suppress spellcasters while their crewmates walk them off the plank.

This item can be delivered to the Harbor Commodity Vendor in a harbor to gain Materials.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Crate of Tidesnapper Liquor

Thick, briny booze fermented in the guts of drowned eels. Smells like low tide and tastes worse. Banned due to its prevalent use in cultist rituals.

This item can be delivered to the Harbor Commodity Vendor in a harbor to gain Materials.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Set of Shrunken Skulls

Kept in a lacquered box padded with dried moss, these trophies are considered valuable among heretics. Each skull appears shrunken and treated with jungle resin, and a delicate silver thread seals the mouth shut.

6064633465720799268.title: Voided Siege Declaration Banner - Shorefoot
6064633465720799268.description: Voided siege declaration due to price issues.

6064633498991722518.title: Braidwood Rooting Ball
6064633498991722518.description: This self-fertilizing root ball that will grow braidwood when planted in a freehold.

6064633504623165441.title: Bucktown Medium Estate Deed
6064633504623165441.description: Test item for freehold deeds in the Marketplace

6064633527213162841.title: Sparkveil Jerkin
6064633527213162841.description: Fitted for agility, its layers breathe easily in the heat of the forge while offering enough guard to turn aside a sudden strike.

6064633584388276240.title: Recipe: Sandsquall Desert Treasure Map
6064633584388276240.description: Apprentice Scribe recipe for Sandsquall Desert Treasure Map.

A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Kal Torhum.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Kal Torhum to place this banner.

6064633657232719877.title: Stationary Ballista
6064633657232719877.description: Right click this item to launch the ballista at the targeted location

6064633696457261064.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Brinebarrel
6064633696457261064.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Brinebarrel.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Brinebarrel to place this banner.

6064633775705555110.title: Bottles of Bittergem Brandy
6064633775705555110.description:
Sweet and searing, made from distilled cavern berries.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Crate of Braided Beard Charms

Miniature iron or gem charms woven into beards for blessing or prestige.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Frostleaf Tea Bricks

Pressed blocks of minty tea leaves from icy plateaus.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Bundle of Mountain Lion Fur

Warm, durable fur from fierce predators of the high cliffs.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Caveclover Honey

Thick, dark honey from subterranean bees; potent and rare.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Create of Ancestral Totems

Carved figures said to house dwarven ancestor spirits.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064633786054344713.title: Ramkin Key
6064633786054344713.description: A large heavy key. It is unlike any other key you know of. Grooves at the end hint that it might be used to turn something.

sources.name: Defeat Ramkin along your way to the settlement at Bonfire

6064633787245133860.title: Crimson-Obsidian Gem
6064633787245133860.description: An exquisite red and black gem. It shimmers with vibrant color. It is as slippery as a fish.

sources.name: As you watch the water shimmer, a fish stirs beneath the surface. Sleek, steely-scaled, half the size of your hand, it rises from the depths. Tiny bubbles trail from its lips like silver pearls. Cradled in its jaw is something unexpected: a glistening red and black faceted stone shines in the thing's mouth. It pauses there, almost as if it is offering the thing to you.

6064633860906680337.title: Thornway Accord Hood
6064633860906680337.description: Worn low by custom, not by choice. The eyes beneath saw too far, too often.

6064633860907139095.title: Oathdelve Mantle
6064633860907139095.description: Once donned by the keepers of names that cannot be written.

6064633860908187679.title: Tithebrook Bindings
6064633860908187679.description: Creases only in places touched by guilt, though never the wearer's own.

6064633860910350395.title: Starlight Creed Pauldrons
6064633860910350395.description: These pauldrons shimmer faintly like the horizon before a storm. Worn long enough, they begin to carry the cadence of distant bells across open water.

6064633860915921047.title: Cindermarch Belt
6064633860915921047.description: Binds the armor in place with the same precision as a master's join, each strap and clasp set where the hand finds it first.

6064633860916773031.title: Gritmantle Shoulders
6064633860916773031.description: Curve broad and low, built to bear the weight of both the armor and the burden of command in the field.

6064633860920312039.title: Wildmarch Gloves
6064633860920312039.description: Toughened along the palm, each stitch holding fast against the grind of rope, stone, and leather reigns.

6064633860920574192.title: Coalhewn Gloves
6064633860920574192.description: Close with the secure hold of a seasoned smith, steady enough to keep grip through grit, rain, or the shock of a blow.

6064633860948820284.title: Verdant Yoke Cuirass
6064633860948820284.description: Layered in barksteel and moss-treated hide, this chestplate holds the scent of wet soil and stubborn life. Its bearer feels drawn to trails that others miss.

6064633860949147978.title: Crownbreaker Greaves
6064633860949147978.description: Bent at the knee from long marches through reed and ruin, these greaves have carried their bearers over the bones of the faithful and the false. Each dent tells where the line broke, then held.

6064633860950917455.title: Luminous Concord Sabatons
6064633860950917455.description: Each step lands with more finality than intended, as if answering to something buried deeper than stone. They resist stillness when oaths remain unfinished.

6064633860950917457.title: Luminous Concord Gauntlets
6064633860950917457.description: The grip steadies before thought catches up. Those who wear them often find their hands clenched in moments they do not recall deciding.

6064633860971561304.title: Stormcanon Boots
6064633860971561304.description: Smoothed by tide and time, these boots carry the hush of wind-carved coves. Each step remembers slick stone, shifting sand, and the soft hush of breakers against forgotten piers.

6064633860971561310.title: Stormcanon Girdle
6064633860971561310.description: Woven from salt-stiffened cords and sun-hardened fiber, this girdle clings like reef to shore. It holds firm through lean and gale alike, grounding its bearer with the memory of still waters before the surge.

6064633860971823459.title: Sunwrought Gloves
6064633860971823459.description: These gloves feel shaped more by memory than by hand, their surface holding the warmth of vanished cities and the silent vows made in dust-choked chambers.

6064633860984275390.title: Graveplate Helm
6064633860984275390.description: Seals the gaze within a narrow field of purpose, cutting through gloom and shadow so the wearer sees only the path that must be taken.

6064633860985717203.title: Coralhold Faulds
6064633860985717203.description: Encircle the waist with the layered defense of the reef, shielding the body's core as the coral walls shield the teeming life within.

6064633860986044887.title: Scaldplate Bracers
6064633860986044887.description: Encircle the arms with the strength of tempered metal left to cool beneath a red sky, ready for either the shield's guard or the strike?s follow-through.

6064633860986372574.title: Cryptward Cuirass
6064633860986372574.description: Holds the chest as the ancient vaults hold their secrets, every line a warding mark against the things that claw in silence just beyond the stone.

6064633860986372576.title: Cryptward Bracers
6064633860986372576.description: Encircle the arms with the same iron will that holds the crypt gates shut, steadying each blow as if carved into the design of the armor itself.

6064633860987224558.title: Stoneglen Girdle
6064633860987224558.description: Binds the armor with the unity of mortar in the wall, keeping every plate true to its place when the fight presses close.

6064633860987486708.title: Anvilguard Helm
6064633860987486708.description: From behind its visor, the world narrows to what must be faced. Noise and chaos pass over like storms above the peaks.

6064633860987945469.title: Reefguard Helm
6064633860987945469.description: Crowns the head like the high point of a sea wall, granting the gaze a clear view across the horizon where danger gathers.

6064633860998300188.title: Thistlemaw Hood
6064633860998300188.description: Dampens the voice slightly, enough to be noticed but not explained.

6064633860998300195.title: Thistlemaw Grips
6064633860998300195.description: Prickles when worn too far east, though the reason is not widely agreed upon.

6064633860998562341.title: Runebreath Cowl
6064633860998562341.description: Drawn low in reverence, though no altar has stood in its presence for an age.

6064633860998562348.title: Runebreath Grips
6064633860998562348.description: Each finger closes over silence, but opens on a phrase the wearer doesn't recall speaking.

6064633860999479864.title: Candlefen Trousers
6064633860999479864.description: Worn by those who never sat, only stood between dusk and deeper things.

6064633860999479866.title: Candlefen Cloak
6064633860999479866.description: It never catches the wind, even when the storm is near.

6064633861004132935.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Gloves
6064633861004132935.description: Threaded with quiet radiance, these gloves retain the memory of old devotions. Their touch leaves no mark on stone or steel, but within them lingers the hush of sealed vaults and whispered prayers beneath mountain sky.

6064633861004657230.title: Unfallen Rainment Boots
6064633861004657230.description: Salt-worn and sky-stitched, these boots carry the rhythm of distant breakers in every step. Their soles remember stone altars long since drowned, where vows were whispered to tides that never recede.

6064633861004657232.title: Unfallen Rainment Gloves
6064633861004657232.description: Salt-stiffened at the seams and forever damp to the touch, these gloves seem woven from storm-filtered light. Their grip remains sure even in the wettest tempests, as though shaped by a sailor's final oath whispered to the deep.

6064633861005247058.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Coif
6064633861005247058.description: This head coif carries the stillness of sealed chambers where even echoes fear to stir. Behind its veil, the bearer sees through heat and time, glimpsing the truths buried beneath a thousand dunes.

6064633861005247066.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Cape
6064633861005247066.description: This draping shell bears the faded warmth of forgotten devotion. The stitching clings to old rites, as if the desert itself remembers the prayers once spoken beneath sun-shattered skies.

6064633861010162332.title: Seafoam Shoulders
6064633861010162332.description: Lie close against the frame, shaped to slip easily past rigging or through narrow gangways.

6064633861010424490.title: Dustwhisper Gloves
6064633861010424490.description: Grip with subtle firmness, their touch sure even when the air swirls with dust and the horizon blurs.

6064633861010752175.title: Shadeweft Sash
6064633861010752175.description: Binds the set together in a balanced knot, its ties resting flat so nothing catches in the close press of the jungle.

6064633861012521671.title: Mistglean Head
6064633861012521671.description: Falls low to shield the eyes, turning the glare of the open water into a softened glow that leaves the gaze steady.

6064633861013832418.title: Brightgrove Hood
6064633861013832418.description: Shadows the eyes beneath its brim, letting the gaze travel unnoticed through bright glades and dark hollows alike.

6064633861014291191.title: Seawisp Faulds
6064633861014291191.description: Binds the layers in place with a quiet knot, its tails lifting slightly as if stirred by a breath from the open sea.

6064633861014291193.title: Seawisp Boots
6064633861014291193.description: Step without sound on wet deck or tide pool stone, their tread leaving only the briefest mark before it is washed away.

6064633861238568297.title: Runic Sigil
6064633861238568297.description: A round, flat sigil carved from dusky red stone. On one side, an inscription of a rune is engraved onto the surface.

sources.name: The sockets are smooth and appear designed to hold something circular or gem-like.

6064633866775691291.title: Glimmerbound Ring
6064633866775691291.description: Wrapped in twisted channel-wire and veilshard scrap, this ring once circled the finger of a Veilhold echo-weaver. It hums in cadence with arcane rhythm, quickening thought through the hand that bears it.

6064633866775887901.title: Glimmerbound Earring
6064633866775887901.description: Delved from a sealed reliquary deep in the Glimmersoot halls, this shard-bound earring reflects light even in perfect dark. Thought stirs faster when the gleam sharpen

6064633866782113844.title: Driftwrought Necklace
6064633866782113844.description: Its links carry the faint ripple of shorebreak, each curve smoothed as if by long passage through salt and spray.

6064633866784473151.title: Duneburied Ring
6064633866784473151.description: Matte finish with subtle striations like wind laid layers, the color holding the quiet of starlit marches between dunes.

6064633866784538688.title: Duneburied Necklace
6064633866784538688.description: Fine grains linger in hidden seams, a relic scent of spice and distant caravans clinging to the metal as though it remembers the map of the dunes.

6064633866786111555.title: Hollowbound Necklace
6064633866786111555.description: A seal shaped charm marked with inward turning lines, its face holds the stillness of doors kept shut for centuries beneath tangled roots.

6064633866788864074.title: Djinnblessed Ring
6064633866788864074.description: A slim band inscribed with drifting sigils, faint warmth pooling where the finger and metal meet.

6064633866957160535.title: Coralblade Axe
6064633866957160535.description: Widened by undertow and tempered in saltlight, this heavy blade echoes the cadence of the deep. Those who wield it often strike in time with unseen currents.

6064633867062280293.title: Shadowfang Axe
6064633867062280293.description: A lean, low-glint profile, its balance favors silent approach and a finish that keeps moonlight at bay.

6064633867083186298.title: Ashbrand Great Axe
6064633867083186298.description: Once wielded by those who stood within the molten heart of the Anvils, this axe bears the weight of a hundred buried wars. Its edge holds fast even in silence.

6064633867100684438.title: Ironhearth Spell Book
6064633867100684438.description: Heavy in the hands and warm even when closed, the Ironhearth Spell Book carries a quiet pressure, like something sealed inside. When opened near flame, faint lines emerge between the text, as though the page is remembering more than it shows.

6064633867115298984.title: Mirageborn Great Grimoire
6064633867115298984.description: Chapter marks shift like heat haze at the horizon, guiding the gaze in gentle arcs that always return to the line.

6064633867119427759.title: Mistwood Dagger
6064633867119427759.description: Narrow and silent, the Mistwood Dagger reflects no stars, even when the night is clear. It is often missing from where it was left, only to be found where shadow runs deep.

6064633867171332296.title: Ironhearth Focus
6064633867171332296.description: Dense and unadorned, the Ironhearth Focus carries a quiet weight that seems to settle thought. When used in meditation, faint vibrations echo through the wrist and into the stone beneath.

6064633867174412492.title: Coralblade Focus
6064633867174412492.description: Salt-rimed and slick to the touch, this relic refuses dust and calls to things beneath the waves.

6064633867179720924.title: Deepweld Focus
6064633867179720924.description: Dense and grounded, the metal core set deep within its forged frame.

6064633867186077932.title: Flameheart Longbow
6064633867186077932.description: Faint warmth lingers in the grip, recalling the breath of the forge at dusk.

6064633867198464250.title: Stoneforge Mace
6064633867198464250.description: Solid and spare, the Stoneforge Mace feels heavier when lifted in doubt. It leaves faint dust rings on surfaces it never touched.

6064633867202199814.title: Sunscorch Mace
6064633867202199814.description: Flat planes mute the glare, keeping its lines true under the desert's gaze.

6064633867203248393.title: Wavecutter Mace
6064633867203248393.description: Streamlined and poised, its form moves with the easy surety of a prow through calm seas.

6064633867204493581.title: Stormcurrent Mace
6064633867204493581.description: Cool to the touch, its shape channels the restless pull of open water.

6064633867204886799.title: Dreadwake Mace
6064633867204886799.description: Darkened iron carries the hush of shadowed waters and slow currents.

6064633867210785041.title: Ironhearth Great Mace
6064633867210785041.description: Forged for siegebreakers, the Ironhearth Great Mace lands with a sound like cracked stone. It grows warm with use and does not cool easily.

6064633867226513723.title: Ashbrand Rapier
6064633867226513723.description: Forged in the deepfast heat beneath Dhurgrum's silence, this blade is slender as smoke and twice as elusive. Each thrust trails warmth that never quite fades.

6064633867227038013.title: Sandcarved Rapier
6064633867227038013.description: Etched by desert gales and scar-born glyphs, this rapier flickers with precision drawn from silence and stillness. Its weight feels absent, its strike absolute.

6064633867243159914.title: Nightreaver Scepter
6064633867243159914.description: Matte finish swallows stray glints, leaving the suggestion of form more than its shine.

6064633867255218572.title: Sandcarved Shortbow
6064633867255218572.description: Balanced for sudden winds and treacherous dunes, its arc follows the logic of sunlit mirages and dry silence.

6064633867275796932.title: Stoneforge Sword
6064633867275796932.description: Cut straight and balanced for endurance, the Stoneforge Sword carries a quiet gravity. It rings flat when dropped and buries its tip in stone with no sound at all.

6064633867279270353.title: Shadowfang Sword
6064633867279270353.description: The edge is narrow and dark, recalling the bite of unseen hunters in the Jundark gloom.

6064633867287200233.title: Shadowfang Greatsword
6064633867287200233.description: The serrated edge gleams like a smile in the dark. Its bite is quicker than sight.

6064633867294147070.title: Flameheart Wand
6064633867294147070.description: A dull ember glows at its center, pulsing with each heartbeat. The warmth is both comfort and warning.

6064633867295654404.title: Mirageborn Wand
6064633867295654404.description: Its edges blur when seen from the corner of the eye. The air bends faintly around it.

6064633867295851013.title: Nightreaver Wand
6064633867295851013.description: Its surface swallows light until only shadow remains. The quiet it brings feels deliberate.

6064633867296899593.title: Dreadwake Wand
6064633867296899593.description: Its shaft feels damp to the touch, carrying the chill of open water. A faint echo of waves follows each movement.

6064633895604256773.title: Mount Cosmetic: Cursed Charger
6064633895604256773.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Forged through forbidden magic, the Cursed Charger is a fearsome feline bred for violence and speed. Its quill-covered hide and glowing bands mark the success of Yula the Damned?s infamous ritual, performed in desperation after years of failed enchantments. Once a proud predator of Verra?s open plains, the creature was transformed into a relentless, battle-hungry mount, obeying only the one who commands it. Though Yula was struck down, her twisted legacy endures through these rare, volatile beasts that move like shadows and strike without hesitation.

6064633895693320241.title: Mount Cosmetic: Tidesnapper
6064633895693320241.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your aquatic mount.
more: With a low-slung shell streaked in salt and seafoam, the Tidesnapper moves like a shadow beneath the waves. When danger nears, it bursts forth with shocking speed, jaws snapping shut with a crack like splintering wood. A stealthy and sudden mount for those who ride the tides.

6064633895728513096.title: Cosmetic: Prickly Pollywog
6064633895728513096.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895728840778.title: Cosmetic: Embered Kit
6064633895728840778.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895762788439.title: Mount Cosmetic: Lightfoot Leveret
6064633895762788439.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Despite its towering size, the Lightfoot Leveret bounds with uncanny agility, darting through brush and bramble like a creature half its weight. This oversized forest hare is favored by messengers, scouts, and mischief-makers who prize speed and silence in equal measure. With ears attuned to every rustle and paws that barely touch the ground, it makes a nimble and watchful mount for those who must move swiftly through the wilds.

6064633895781859427.title: Mount Cosmetic: Jaded Drudger
6064633895781859427.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: With a hide like moss-covered shale and a temperament to match, the Jaded Drudger is the beast of burden for riders who measure progress in leagues and not in moments. Its sluggish gait conceals remarkable endurance, carrying weighty loads across harsh terrain without pause or protest. Though it seems to scowl at the world with each plodding step, the Drudger never falters, never tires, and never forgets the path it has once tread.

6064633895829241986.title: Cosmetic: Drill Spiderling
6064633895829241986.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633900518014988.title: Glorybound Stonebind Axe
6064633900518014988.description: A wreathwork etch circles the socket, quiet and sure, as if triumph were a craft learned by degrees.

6064633900520308755.title: Runeweld Echo-Axe
6064633900520308755.description: Drawn from alloy stirred under chanting breath, the Runeweld Echo-Axe carries faint impressions of voices never heard aloud. Its edge hums when near ancient masonry, and the haft bears a knot that some mistake for a listening ear. Scholars believe the runes etched into its core are not words, but echoes waiting to return.

6064633900552290352.title: Mistwood Hollowfang
6064633900552290352.description: Bound with rootthread and carved under eclipse, the Mistwood Hollowfang bears an edge that seems to drink the light. When left unattended, it's often found resting blade-down in soil, no matter how it was placed before.

6064633900678709385.title: Coralblade Maelstrom-Spear
6064633900678709385.description: Weightless yet wrathful, it channels the surge of abyssal spirals, where light breaks and memory sinks.

6064633900695355552.title: Stoneforge Pinnacle
6064633900695355552.description: The Stoneforge Pinnacle plants itself without sway, even on uneven ground. Its tip rings once when held against lies, and the sound travels farther than expected in still air.

6064633900704268457.title: Coralblade Maelstrom-Codex
6064633900704268457.description: Forged in the churning silence beneath storm-torn waves, its pages shimmer with shifting script, like tidemarks that vanish when sought.

6064633900706431151.title: Coralblade Reef-Shortbow
6064633900706431151.description: Strung tight with current-song and curved like a gull's dive, it bears the breathless stillness of the deep and the bite of something older beneath.

6064633900738150598.title: Dreadwake Undertow Longbow
6064633900738150598.description: Each release carries a quiet pull, like the drag of a current below sight.

6064633900739199177.title: Dreadwake Maelgrim Greatsword
6064633900739199177.description: Dark waters churn within the steel, glimpsed in moments between breaths. The roar of unseen waves follows its swing.

6064633900753223892.title: Flameheart Stonegrip Twin Daggers
6064633900753223892.description: A quiet ember hue settles at the bevels, brightening as the blades find their rhythm.

6064633900781207772.title: Glassveil Sunwrought Twin Daggers

6064633900800934121.title: Ironhearth Magmashear
6064633900800934121.description: The Ironhearth Magmashear glows faintly at its core and leaves scorched impressions even on steel. When swung in anger, its edge flares red and trembles with suppressed force.

6064633900871516434.title: Pyrebrand Emberfang Wand
6064633900871516434.description: Sparks drift lazily from its tip before fading. The heat lingers in the air long after it passes.

6064633900876759316.title: Runeweld Dirk
6064633900876759316.description: When unsheathed, the Runeweld Dirk carries a whisper not heard by all, trailing behind like breath in cold air. Its markings shift subtly when decisions are made nearby.

6064633900877283606.title: Runeweld Sigilbow
6064633900877283606.description: Bound with vine and supple as a sapling, the Verdant Oath Longbow bends without sound and rights itself without strain. Its grip is always warm, and small insects gather near when it is still.

6064633900900679979.title: Seabright Tidefast Great Grimoire
6064633900900679979.description: Tar scented binding and stout thread hold firm in damp air, a pale sea green glint following the light.

6064633900903956787.title: Seabright Tideforged Wand
6064633900903956787.description: Tiny waves crest and vanish along its grain. Its movements echo the pull of a hidden tide.

6064633900926959938.title: Stoneforge Edgekeeper
6064633900926959938.description: The Stoneforge Edgekeeper holds its sharpness through ash and time alike. When gripped in silence, the blade gleams faintly and aligns with the bearer's center of balance.

6064633900927287619.title: Stoneforge Vindicator
6064633900927287619.description: The Stoneforge Vindicator grows colder in moments of doubt and strikes with the sound of closing stone. Its arc leaves a line in the air that fades only when the wielder's intent is resolved.

6064633921832550403.description: Novice Armorsmithing recipe for creating Crownbreaker Forearms

6064634325307424772.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed

more: Cloaked in wind and crowned in sunlight, the Eagle Gryphon reigns over the skies with a presence both regal and unrelenting. Its wings span like the banners of forgotten empires, each feather sharp with purpose and etched with the memory of high places. The lion's strength coils beneath its taloned grace, and its cry carries like a trumpet over stone and treetop. Forged in the thin air of ancient mountain thrones, the Eagle Gryphon is a creature of clarity and command, drawn to those who rule not with secrecy but with vision cast wide and true. It serves the Mayor of Winstead alone, recognizing in them the soul of a leader who does not follow the path but charts it.

6064634489926057991.title: Canticle of the Hollow Deep
6064634489926057991.description: This tome does not speak, it sings. When opened, ink drips upward, forming glyphs that shimmer with bioluminescent cadence before vanishing into the fold. Each page breathes, exhaling harmonic tones that never repeat, yet seem always remembered. As its bearer reads, voices swell in the distance. Not words, but choral resonance, layered and inhuman. Bound in spirals, the book?s pages turn with the tide, sometimes forward, sometimes back. Its final verse is never fixed, forever drowning in its own echo.

6064634489931104267.title: Veilpiercer's Torc
6064634489931104267.description: A twisted circlet of dark alloy, smooth as glass and warm to the touch. At its center pulses a faint, violet ember, never bright, never dim, beating to a rhythm that matches no mortal heart. Those who wear it speak less, but dream more.

6064634518645506148.title: Bastion of the Forgotten Voice
6064634518645506148.description: The shield bears no crest, no heraldry, only a single recessed ring at its center that pulses with hollow rhythm. Its surface is marked with concentric scars, as though it has turned aside countless attacks made by those who no longer exist. The edge is rough and slightly uneven, like a word half-spoken then swallowed. It does not ring when struck. It absorbs sound and memory alike, reflecting nothing but stillness.

6064634574539718662.description: Through the Song of Restoration, this ancient scythe has been reborn. Its crescent blade shines with radiant white-gold light, the once-dark veins now shimmering like captured starlight. The weapon is enchanted with Aeterna's essence, resolute and clear, ready to sever corruption at its root and stand against Qluud's dominion.

6064634597680545795.title: Whispersunk Lens
6064634597680545795.description: Forged from memory-stained glass dredged from the depths, this arcane lens contains no image, only distortion. Its surface shifts with unseen tides, blurring reflection into echo. When spellwork passes through it, the magic ripples backward and inward, resonating with commands long forgotten - or never truly known. Those who gaze too long into its depths often speak names not their own.  The sea does not forget.Through this, it remembers for you.

more: Lumbering and lumpy, the Dredgehorn is an amphibious brute that trades elegance for raw utility. Its primary weapon is a lightning-fast tongue that can yank prey from a distance, though when provoked, it charges headlong with a horn strong enough to shatter bone. Tamed through sheer patience and copious amounts of marsh grubs, the Dredgehorn serves as a functional, if stomach-turning mount for riders with strong legs and stronger stomachs. Few creatures can match its power in wetlands or boggy terrain, where its bulk and spring-loaded stride offer surprising mobility.

6064634738728501256.title: A well-used tin holding Soonu's collection of Gloomtrout flies. Shapes and threads chosen by tradition, each one tied to call the deep-pool trout to the line.

6064634754501050368.title: Heartwood Soup
6064634754501050368.description: Tomumua's signature dish is a thick, gravy-brown gruel simmered with Heartwood Roots and sprinkled with a spicy garnish whose recipe remains a mystery.

6064634761961734166.title: Ironshod Animus
6064634761961734166.description: A compact reliquary of binding rites, etched with Dunzen clauses of will. Among the Minotaur it held feuds at bay. When called, it is like a sealed gate listening close to your intent, then answering.

6064634761974120516.title: Peltreaper's Hushbow
6064634761974120516.description: A longbow stolen from a ruined watch post and reworked for silent raids. Its limbs carry tally scratches of caravans taken and vows broken. When drawn, it feels like the hills holding their breath, waiting for the arrow that ends an argument.

6064634762080223248.title: Gilded Sump Hood
6064634762080223248.description: A medium helm pulled from the Drain?s slick chambers, its inner lining scrawled with superstition against creeping things. Wearing it is like stepping under a low ceiling of old fear, yet feeling your thoughts sharpen instead of shrink.
